email.certificate.verify.heading: Label above the direct verification link in email.
email.common.footer.copyright: Footer copyright text in transactional emails. {year} is current year, {org} is organization name.
email.password-reset.subject: Subject line for admin password reset email. {org} is the organization name.
email.password-reset.heading: Main heading in admin password recovery email.
email.password-reset.body: Body paragraph explaining the reset request. {username} is admin username, {org} is organization name.
email.password-reset.instructions: Instructions explaining button click and token expiry. {minutes} is expiry duration in minutes.
email.password-reset.btn-reset: Button text in email linking to password reset screen.
email.password-reset.disclaimer: Security disclaimer in email telling user to ignore if not requested.
email.notification.subject: Subject line for the participant certificate availability email. {event} is the event name.
email.notification.heading: Personalized greeting in the certificate availability email. {name} is the recipient's full name.
email.notification.body: Main message informing the recipient that their certificate is available to claim. {event} is the event name, {org} is the organization name.
email.notification.instructions: Instructions on how to claim and download the certificate from the portal.
email.notification.btn-portal: Call-to-action button text in notification email linking to the portal.
email.notification.disclaimer: Reminder disclaimer about using the registered email address. {email} is the recipient's email address.
category.photography-competition: Label for the 'Photography Competition' event category.
category.learning-course: Label for the 'Learning Course' event category.
category.testing-event: Label for the 'Testing Event' event category.
admin.editor.color.extracted-label: Label above the color swatches auto-detected from the uploaded certificate template (issue #90). Only shown when at least one color was detected.
admin.editor.color.extracted-title: Tooltip suffix on each auto-detected swatch, appended after the hex code (e.g. '#106B9A — auto-detected from your uploaded template — click to apply').
admin.editor.color.brand-label: Label above the organiser's saved custom color presets (issue #90).
admin.editor.color.save-current: Button that saves the currently selected color as a reusable brand preset.
admin.editor.color.save-current-title: Title attribute (tooltip) on the '+ Save current' button.
admin.editor.color.brand-hint: Help text under the brand color presets row explaining the interaction.
admin.editor.color.none-yet: Placeholder text shown in the brand presets row when the organiser hasn't saved any custom colors yet.
admin.editor.tab.properties: Tab label for the element properties inspector panel in the visual certificate editor.
admin.editor.tab.layers: Tab label for the layers panel and canvas grid settings in the visual certificate editor.
admin.editor.color.custom-toggle: Button/header label to expand or collapse the advanced HSL color sliders and eyedropper tool.
